thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 95p latency spike observed on kv-cache + continuous-batching path in us-west-2 starting at 2024-11-02T02:31:30Z. Error spike: increased 5xx (504) and request timeouts. Affected service: runtime-batcher, kv-cache. Auto-escalation to #incidents.

ops-bot: Top symptoms: sustained kv cache size growth (+12x aggregate), pack latency rising, pack_worker saturation on several GPU nodes. Linked dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ops/kv-batch (auto-snapshot).

sara_oncall: I'm paged, on it. Looking at the batcher logs and KV eviction traces now. Initial reading: a mixed workload (many long-context safety checks + high-rate short completion queries) caused packer to group heavy requests and long requests are monopolizing KV eviction/IO.

jiro: I can confirm. On one host nvme I/O to prefetch backend jumped and KV cache memory kept growing (lots of post-quantized tensors pinned). Paging events increased and continuous-batching queue length shot up.

natalia_sre: Customer-facing impact? Any 429/timeout churn to report to CS?

customer-success-bot: Several customers reported increased API 504s and degraded streaming. Top impacted: two high-throughput dev accounts in prod-us-west. CS notified and triaging.

maggie_pm: Escalate priority — this aligns with dedicated-customer SLOs. Please provide ETA for mitigation.

sara_oncall: Triage plan: 1) Stop aggressive KV prefetch for packers (reduce prefetch window) 2) Force packer fairness: prefer small requests in scheduler (temp config) 3) Patch continuous-batcher to limit max_pack_tokens and disable pack merging for long-context requests 4) Roll a canary with hotfix, monitor 95/99 latencies and eviction rate.

luca_eng: I'll prepare the runtime patch. Proposed quick config change (runtime config):

```yaml
batch_scheduler:
  fairness_policy: small-first
  max_pack_tokens: 1024  # ramp down from 8192
  pack_merge_enabled: false
kv_cache:
  prefetch_window_ms: 50   # was 500
  eviction_threshold_ratio: 0.75
```

luca_eng: Plan to apply as runtime config flag and then do a rolling restart of packer pods.

jiro: Also we'll temporarily lift kv-cache hang protection timeout to avoid hard evictions mid-requests (reduce thrashing).

sara_oncall: Good. I'm going to throttle incoming traffic to reduce tail risk while we roll. Use route policy to divert non-critical customers to secondary region.

deploy-bot: CI job queued for branch hotfix/kv-batch-fairness-173256. Build passed.

luca_eng: Applying change to canary subset (3 pods) now: `kubectl patch deployment runtime-packer -n prod --patch "$(cat patch.yaml)"` then `kubectl rollout status`.

sara_oncall: Command that trimmed prefetch (executed):
```
# temporarily reduce prefetch window
curl -XPOST "https://ops-api.redwood.internal/v1/runtime/config" -d '{"kv_cache.prefetch_window_ms":50}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

jiro: Observability: eviction_rate has already dropped 60% on canary nodes, pack_queue_length down ~40%, 95p latency for mixed workload from 1.8s -> 350ms on canary.

natalia_sre: Any accidental regressions? Check throughput impact and cost. Also watch memory pressure.

luca_eng: Canary looks stable for 6 minutes. No OOMs and throughput is within 10% of baseline. I'm rolling to the remainder of packer fleet incrementally (10% at a time).

maggie_pm: Noted. Sending customer update: "We observed transient latency and timeout increases in us-west-2. We implemented a mitigation that reduces aggressive batching and prefetching; this should restore normal latencies. We'll follow up with a full postmortem."

customer-success-bot: Customer pinged: "Thanks, noticing improvement."

ops-bot: Auto-check after roll step: 95p latencies back to normal region-wide, kv cache sizes stabilized. Some residual 504 reports but trending down.

sara_oncall: Marking incident severity as Sev2 (production impact but mitigation successful). Handoff to eng-runtime (luca) and eng-sre (natalia) for follow-up: full postmortem, root cause, and long-term fix (scheduler fairness algorithm + KV ownership isolation).

natalia_sre: I'll capture timeline and metrics. Assigning postmortem to @luca_eng and @jiro. Please include: incident trigger, config deltas, logs, and customer impact matrix.

luca_eng: Immediate actions for follow-up: 1) Add packer-level admission control to prevent long requests from entering the fast pack queue 2) Improve KV prefetch heuristic to be workload-aware 3) Add perf test to our CI that mixes long/short requests to surface regression earlier.

sara_oncall: Leaving the channel, handoff complete. If any regression reappears @here.

jiro: Dropping final commands used for rollback/rollout for audit: 
```
# rollback canary quickly if needed
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-packer -n prod --to-revision=42
# full rollout
kubectl set image deployment/runtime-packer runtime-packer=registry.redwood/release/runtime-packer:hotfix-173256 -n prod
```

maggie_pm: Filing CS follow-up: auto-notify impacted accounts with root-cause note after postmortem.

natalia_sre: Postmortem action items created in JIRA: RED-9812 (scheduler fairness), RED-9813 (kv-prefetch heuristics), RED-9814 (synthetic mixed-workload test).

ops-bot: Incident timeline recorded. Closing active pager.

sara_oncall: :thumbsup: Good work team."
